notes: The prompt self-declares First-Person Shooter and gun game is the free-for-all end of the genre, so Arena Deathmatch is the only preset that fits — the eight competitive-mode presets all assume two teams. I substituted open-battlefield for the preset's lane-network because the answers explicitly rejected opposing-team lanes in favour of a compact loop with spawns spread around it, and kept the preset's path-loop and cover-elevated (the Factory map's interconnected warehouses and rooftops) while dropping powerup-buffs, since in gun game the next weapon comes from an elimination rather than from the floor. Only the Factory map is in scope per the answers and the other four are separate builds later, so this is one map and not P4; warehouses entered from outside carry P3 and the rooftops are tiered rather than overhanging, which keeps this off P2. With no user to ask I assumed 8-player sizing as answered, that the arena loops rather than terminating (so no finish objective — the win is the Golden Knife elimination, which is gameplay, not layout), and that the conveyors and crates supply the distributed cover.
